calls.statement:
SELECT m.home_store_id, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FILTER (WHERE m.is_current) AS current_members, sum(CASE WHEN m.is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FILTER (WHERE m.is_current AND m.valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS cur_open, max(m.join_date) AS latest_join, min(m.join_date) AS earliest_join
FROM dim_member m
WHERE m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH tampere_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND store_id < 900
),
cur AS (
  SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tampere_stores)
),
mx AS (SELECT max(sale_date) AS last_sale FROM fact_sales_line),
act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN cur ON cur.member_id = m.member_id, mx
  WHERE f.sale_date > mx.last_sale - 364
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cur) AS cur_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM cur) AS cur_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM act) AS active_52w, (SELECT last_sale FROM mx) AS last_sale,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tampere_stores)) AS ever_tampere,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND marketing_consent AND home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tampere_stores)) AS consent
